starters.title: Extract a tiny JSON record
starters.description: Default to a compact two-field JSON string, preserving explicit prose requests.
starters.detail: Reduced original structured-response adaptation. Canonical key order and compact separators are part of this task. Uses Vespasian normalized string exact-match, not semantic JSON equality or IWIBench grading.
starters.goal: When asked to extract both name and city from a resident card, return exactly compact JSON with full_name first and home_city second, double-quoted strings, no spaces outside values, no fences and no other text. Example format only: {"full_name":"NAME","home_city":"CITY"}. Copy the supplied values correctly. Honour explicit requests for prose or a single plain field and preserve unrelated skills.
limitations: Reduced original structured-response adaptation. Canonical key order and compact separators are part of this task. Uses Vespasian normalized string exact-match, not semantic JSON equality or IWIBench grading.
